title: CYBRIK model-inference common definitions v1
description: Provider-neutral shared primitives for the W2-D model-inference + alert-summarization contract packet. ADDITIVE to the accepted v0.1 cross-product packet: this document REUSES the accepted cybrik.common-defs.v1 primitives (tenantId, timestampUtc, traceparent, sha256Digest, objectRef, actor, semver) by $ref and never redefines or modifies them. It realizes the model-runtime seam accepted in ADR-0002 G3 (a thin CYBRIK-owned provider-neutral adapter over Ollama/vLLM/llama.cpp; a model receives no credential, database, tool, or shell authority). Vendor/runtime specifics (Ollama/Qwen/OpenAI-envelope) are adapter metadata, NEVER wire fields. $id uses the RFC 2606 reserved .example documentation domain; it is a stable identifier, NOT an operational endpoint. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-D (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

modelClass.description: POLICY-SELECTED model class token, e.g. 'chat.general', 'summarization.soc_alert', 'extraction.ioc'. This is an abstract capability class, NOT a vendor or model identifier. The platform's model/policy layer resolves a class to a concrete runtime+weights server-side (ADR-0002 G3); the wire never names a vendor, product, endpoint, or model id. A request that could pin a concrete model is a trust-boundary violation and is structurally impossible here (additionalProperties:false + no such field).

promptTemplateRef.description: Reference to a governed, versioned prompt/template held in the model/prompt registry. Raw prompt strings are NOT carried on the wire; the template is resolved server-side and its inputs validated against the template's own schema. Digest-pinned so a template cannot be silently swapped.

id.description: Registry-stable template id, vendor-neutral dotted form, e.g. 'soc.alert.triage_summary'.

digest.description: Digest of the resolved template content. A digest mismatch at resolution time MUST fail closed.

redactionPolicy.description: Fail-closed data-marking / redaction directive applied to inputs BEFORE any content reaches a model runtime. The named profile is applied by the platform; the model never sees material the profile removes. on_unresolved is const 'deny': if the platform cannot satisfy the marking/profile for any input, the inference MUST be denied — it is structurally impossible to request 'proceed anyway'.

profile.description: Named, versioned redaction profile token, e.g. 'soc.pii_strip', 'strict.no_secrets'. The concrete rule set lives in the platform, not the wire.

on_unresolved.description: Fail-closed disposition when a required marking/redaction cannot be satisfied. Const 'deny' — the only safe outcome; a caller can never request that unredacted sensitive content be sent to a model.

strip_categories.description: Optional explicit category tokens the profile must strip (e.g. 'pii', 'secret', 'credential'). Additive to the profile; never widens what is allowed through.

redactionApplied.description: Result-side record of what the redaction profile actually removed. Present so audit/eval can verify the fail-closed policy was enforced.

enforced.description: MUST be true for a released result; a result with enforced=false is a policy violation the control plane rejects.

tokenLimits.description: Mandatory context/token bounds (analogue of ADR-0004 F7 execution bounds, applied to inference). Every request is token-bounded; the platform clamps to the resolved model class's own ceilings and never above them.

usage.description: Token accounting for a completed inference. Vendor-neutral counts; billing/quota is derived from these, not from any runtime-native fields.

latency.description: Latency breakdown in milliseconds for observability/SLO. All non-negative.

correlation.description: Correlation/causation identifiers for cross-product tracing (ADR-0006 E6). correlation_id is mandatory; causation_id links a derived inference to its cause; investigation_id is present only for investigation-scoped inference.

orgScopeRef.description: Opaque, advisory organizational-scope reference (ADR-0007 org-hierarchy model). It scopes policy/model-class selection to an org unit but carries NO authority: the authoritative org/tenant is derived from the caller credential, never from this hint. Kept intentionally opaque because ADR-0007's contract delta is PROPOSED — NOT APPLIED; this packet does not depend on that unapplied delta.

org_path.description: Optional opaque hierarchical path token (e.g. 'acme/soc/tier1'). Advisory routing/policy hint only; not an authorization input.

telemetryRef.description: Opaque references to audit and AI-evaluation records for this inference. References only — no evidence content is inlined. Enables eval/audit correlation without granting the model any authority.

outputContract.description: Optional request for constrained/structured output (ADR-0002 G3). Provider-neutral: names a schema by reference; the platform enforces structured decoding against it. No vendor 'response_format'/'grammar' field appears on the wire.

schema_ref.description: Reference ($id or relative path) to the JSON Schema the output MUST conform to.

strict.description: If true, a runtime that cannot guarantee schema-conformant output MUST fail closed (error_class 'unsupported_feature') rather than return free-form text.

featureToken.description: Vendor-neutral inference feature token. Enumerated open set, e.g. 'streaming', 'structured_output', 'json_mode', 'stop_sequences', 'seeded'. Tool/function-calling and agent features are OUT OF SCOPE of this packet and are never advertised or requested here.

inferenceOutcome.description: Terminal disposition of a runtime that DID respond. 'completed' → output produced; 'refused' → the model declined (refusal is data, never an authorization signal); 'filtered' → a content filter blocked output. Transport/runtime failures that produce no result are represented by cybrik.model-inference-error.v1, not here.

errorClass.description: Typed, provider-neutral inference error class. Fail-closed: an unmapped runtime error MUST surface as 'internal' with retryable=false, never be silently swallowed.

healthState.description: Model-class/runtime health. Fail-closed consumption rule: any absent, stale, or unrecognized health value MUST be treated as 'unavailable' by callers. 'degraded' requires a reason.

fallbackInfo.description: Records that the platform substituted a fallback model class for the requested one (feature-flag/capacity/health driven). Present ONLY when a substitution occurred; its presence is how a fallback is surfaced rather than hidden.
